title: Simple app that gets the job done
body:

title: Great app, needs detail work
body:
Overall, this has been a great app to list work things to do. However, there are a few adjustments that would make it even more user friendly. 

It would be great to be able to rearrange the list in the individual dates so that we are able to drag things that we would like to do in order. 

Another is currently the sub tasks when added does not stay as a sub task below the main task which is confusing on which is which. Hence, even though there is the subtask function which is great, it doesn’t make much sense to use it.

title: Great App with Room for Improvement
body:
Overall, I think this is a great reminder app. The interface is clean and looks good.

However, some areas of improvement,
1. Add a widget for iOS devices so that I can easily check my upcoming due tasks
2. Currently tasks cannot be set a time but only a date, I think I should be able to set a time because I don’t always want reminders at midnight if you understand me

Although that are some changes that can be made, I feel that this app is headed in the right direcion!
